Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of the base of G939; to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate:--bring (thrust) down.
BiblicalUsage: Capernaum, lifted up to heaven in its privilege, would be thrust down to hell for refusing the light it had been given.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe privilege without repentance only raises the fall.
